This does not complete the nine dimensions or approve parity.

reactFallback.selectionRationale: Retain the exact 9.74.10 npm tarball and integrity already pinned by the checked-in React API crosswalk. The latest tag is 9.74.11; do not silently change the audit baseline mid-review.

icons.rule: Fluent System Icons asset reference; not a standalone Web Components component.

referenceBaseline.notes: Package versions are pinned to exact npm package versions and dist-tags checked on 2026-10-22. React fallback remains on the verified 9.74.10 crosswalk snapshot even though the latest tag is 9.74.11. Storybook URLs are live deployments and are not assumed to be release-pinned to those package versions. React v9 is used only where the Web Components catalog lacks a comparable reference, and is explicitly cross-platform rather than 1:1. No direct counterpart is recorded rather than silently substituting a non-equivalent component.
